settings.title: Settings & privacy
settings.startupNote: Opens the app only; tracking still waits for your choice.
settings.resume: Resume tracking when PC Wrapped opens
settings.resumeNote: Off by default. If tracking was on when the app closed, it starts again on the next launch.
settings.fullscreenNote: A controller or a film produces no keyboard or mouse input. Full-screen apps stay active for up to 4 hours without it; never while the PC is locked.
settings.appearanceNote: Dark blue is gentler on the eyes in the evening. Follow Windows switches with your system theme.
settings.languageNote: Chosen from your Windows language the first time. Change it here at any time.
settings.storedNote: Daily totals only · 365-day retention · no window titles, screenshots or keyboard monitoring.
settings.exportNote: One row per app per day, as a CSV you can open in a spreadsheet.
prefs.excludedNote: Future activity only. Existing history stays until you separately remove it.
prefs.excludedEmpty: No apps are excluded. Use “Exclude future tracking” on an app in Apps on stage to add one.
prefs.hiddenNote: Still included in your totals and percentages.
prefs.hiddenEmpty: No apps are hidden. Use “Hide on cards” on an app in Apps on stage to add one.
footer: Close this window to keep PC Wrapped in the tray. Choose Quit from the tray menu to exit.
notice.excluded: {app} is excluded from future tracking. Existing history is unchanged.
notice.hidden: {app} stays in your totals and is hidden on cards.
notice.reincluded: {app} will be tracked again. Existing history was not changed.
error.setting: The setting could not be saved.
error.csv: The history could not be exported.
error.previewShow: The card preview could not be displayed. Please try again.
error.preview: The card preview could not be made.
error.save: The card could not be saved.
error.cardSave: The card could not be saved. {reason}
error.csvSave: The CSV could not be saved. {reason}
reason.access: Windows did not allow writing there. Choose another folder, such as Documents or Pictures.
reason.busy: The file is open in another program. Close it and try again.
error.excludeFirst: Exclude this app before removing its past data.
warning.adapterMissing: The Windows activity adapter is missing: {path}
warning.historyUnreadable: Saved history could not be read or safely maintained. It was preserved at {path}; tracking is paused to avoid overwriting it.
warning.windowsOnly: PC Wrapped currently runs on Windows only.
dialog.startupMessage: Would you like PC Wrapped to open when you sign in? This does not start activity tracking.
dialog.startupDetail: Startup is off by default. You can change this later in Settings.
dialog.removeTitle: Also remove this app from past data?
dialog.removeMessage: Permanently remove {app} from saved daily summaries?
dialog.removeDetail: This is separate from excluding future tracking and cannot be undone. Older summaries do not show which app changes involved this app, so those change counts will also be cleared.
dialog.deleteMessage: This permanently deletes all locally saved daily summaries.
dialog.deleteDetail: Tracking will pause. This cannot be undone.
